opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK course; students need to be members, others need at least one year membership.
opportunities.summary: Grants to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence, and registration/tuition for short genetics-related training courses or collaborative visits.

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 (Scheme B), up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, MSc and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists (within six years of PhD viva) who are Genetics Society members with a UK base (or UK‑based conference for non‑UK members).
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics conferences, and virtual conferences, covering travel, accommodation, registration, and related costs.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to fund public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs (UK‑based travel only).

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: up to £2,000 (major sponsorship), smaller amounts for specific sessions

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing a genetics‑themed meeting in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for ad‑hoc genetics meetings not organised by the Society, covering venue‑related costs and optional Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings, with UK links.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support regular themed research meetings for special interest groups, up to £2,000 per year.
